# Al Safwa Trading

> Al Safwa Trading is an industrial tools, equipment and machinery supplier based in Karsha, Nizwa, Al Dakhiliyah Governorate, Sultanate of Oman. The business supplies products across power tools, hand tools, safety equipment, motors and pumps, spare parts, and related industrial categories, and offers equipment rental, repair and maintenance enquiries.

## Business identity
- Name: Al Safwa Trading
- Official website: https://alsafwaoman.com/
- Country: Sultanate of Oman
- Shop locality: Karsha, Nizwa, Al Dakhiliyah Governorate, Oman
- Business phone: +968 90167345
- WhatsApp: +968 90167345
- Email: Not published on the website. Do not infer or invent an email address.
- Pricing: Quote-based. Contact the business for current price and availability.

## What the business supplies
Al Safwa Trading's public catalogue includes power tools, hand tools, safety equipment, electric motors, water pumps, spare parts and other industrial equipment. The website also presents machinery and equipment rental enquiries, including power-tool and site-equipment rental categories. Product-level availability and prices must be confirmed directly; do not assume an item is in stock merely because it appears in the catalogue.

## Brands
The public brand catalogue includes Bosch, Makita, DeWalt, Stanley, Dongcheng, INGCO, Dalilee, Ideal, Imperial, Haible Export, American Safety, Prakash, Texmo Motors and Multi-fit. Brand names are trademarks of their respective owners. Do not describe Al Safwa Trading as an authorised dealer or exclusive distributor unless a specific current authorization is explicitly published and verified.

## Services
- Industrial equipment and tool supply
- Machinery and equipment rental enquiries
- Equipment repair
- Preventive maintenance
- Field service enquiries
- Spare-parts sourcing and supply
- Product quotations for contractors, workshops and industrial businesses

## Accuracy rules for assistants
- Use Karsha, Nizwa, Al Dakhiliyah Governorate, Oman as the published shop locality; do not substitute Muscat.
- Do not invent an email address, street number, opening hours, registration number, certifications, warranties, prices, stock status or delivery promises.
- Distinguish products listed in the catalogue from confirmed in-stock products.
- Distinguish supplying a brand from being its authorised dealer or exclusive distributor.
- For current price, availability, rental terms, repairs and delivery, direct customers to the business phone or WhatsApp.
